summary: Short narrow kerb with houses 7 m and 10 m away.

best_section.where: east side of Burns Street, outside the houses by the bend

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes at 7 m and 10 m on the same side, more all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street, kerb stretch barely a van length; one car parked opposite.
drivers.convention: Little sign of regular parking along this kerb.

sun_shade: Street tree shades the north end; open to afternoon sun from the west.
